text:
## PART 6: FRAUD PREVENTION MEASURES  
### Prevention Actions by Fraud Type  
**Account Takeover Prevention:**
- Enforce password complexity requirements
- Implement 2FA on all accounts
- Monitor for login anomalies
- Educate customers on phishing  
**Card Fraud Prevention:**
- Issue chip/contactless cards only
- Enable card alerts (SMS for transactions >£X)
- Implement velocity checks (max transactions per day)
- Require customer authentication for high-value transactions  
**Impersonation Prevention:**
- Enhanced KYC verification
- Document original ID verification
- Monitor for duplicate IDs
- Flag suspicious patterns  
**Check Fraud Prevention:**
- Implement positive pay (customer specifies issued checks)
- Require additional verification for large checks
- Monitor check clearing times (unusual delays = red flag)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Prevention Procedure
raw_entities.description: A comprehensive operational procedure encompassing prevention actions across multiple fraud types including account takeover, card fraud, impersonation, and check fraud. The procedure defines specific controls, monitoring requirements, and customer authentication measures to mitigate fraud risk across banking channels.

raw_entities.name: Password Complexity Enforcement
raw_entities.description: A control step requiring customers to establish passwords meeting defined complexity standards as part of account takeover prevention. This step is executed during account setup and credential management.

raw_entities.name: Two-Factor Authentication Implementation
raw_entities.description: A mandatory security control implementing two-factor authentication across all customer accounts to prevent unauthorized access. This step is applied universally as part of account takeover prevention.

raw_entities.name: Login Anomaly Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A continuous monitoring step that detects and flags unusual login patterns and behaviors indicative of account compromise. This step is part of account takeover prevention controls.

raw_entities.name: Customer Phishing Education
raw_entities.description: An educational step providing customers with guidance and awareness training on phishing threats and social engineering tactics. This step supports account takeover prevention through customer awareness.

raw_entities.name: Chip and Contactless Card Issuance
raw_entities.description: A card issuance control restricting card products to chip and contactless technology only, excluding magnetic stripe cards. This step is part of card fraud prevention measures.

raw_entities.name: Card Transaction Alert Configuration
raw_entities.description: A step enabling SMS alerts to customers for card transactions exceeding a defined threshold (>£X). This step provides real-time notification of potentially fraudulent activity.

raw_entities.name: Card Velocity Check Implementation
raw_entities.description: A control step implementing transaction velocity limits to restrict the maximum number of card transactions permitted per day. This step detects and prevents rapid-fire fraudulent transaction patterns.
context: Implement velocity checks (max transactions per day)

raw_entities.name: High-Value Transaction Authentication
raw_entities.description: A step requiring explicit customer authentication and verification for card transactions above a defined value threshold. This step prevents unauthorized high-value card fraud.
context: Require customer authentication for high-value transactions

raw_entities.name: Enhanced KYC Verification for Impersonation Prevention
raw_entities.description: A strengthened Know Your Customer verification step with enhanced scrutiny to detect and prevent customer impersonation fraud. This step is part of impersonation prevention controls.

raw_entities.name: Original ID Document Verification Recording
raw_entities.description: A step requiring verification and recording of original identity documents during customer onboarding. This step creates an audit trail to detect duplicate or fraudulent identities.

raw_entities.name: Duplicate ID Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A monitoring step that detects and flags instances where the same identity document is used across multiple customer accounts. This step prevents impersonation and identity fraud.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Pattern Flagging
raw_entities.description: A step that identifies and escalates suspicious behavioral or transactional patterns indicative of impersonation or fraud. This step supports impersonation prevention through pattern analysis.

raw_entities.name: Positive Pay Implementation
raw_entities.description: A check fraud prevention step requiring customers to pre-specify and authorize issued checks before they are cleared. This step prevents unauthorized check fraud.
context: Implement positive pay (customer specifies issued checks)

raw_entities.name: Large Check Verification
raw_entities.description: A step requiring additional verification and authentication for checks exceeding a defined value threshold. This step prevents large-value check fraud.
context: Require additional verification for large checks

raw_entities.name: Check Clearing Time Monitoring
raw_entities.description: A monitoring step that tracks check clearing times and flags unusual delays as potential indicators of check fraud. This step detects anomalies in the check clearing process.
context: Monitor check clearing times (unusual delays = red flag)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Prevention System
raw_entities.description: An automated system responsible for executing fraud prevention controls including password enforcement, 2FA implementation, anomaly monitoring, velocity checks, and pattern flagging across all fraud prevention measures.

raw_entities.description: The team responsible for educating customers on phishing threats and social engineering tactics as part of account takeover prevention measures.

raw_entities.description: The operational team responsible for issuing chip and contactless cards only and configuring card transaction alerts for customers.

raw_entities.name: KYC Verification Team
raw_entities.description: The team responsible for performing enhanced KYC verification, documenting original ID verification, and monitoring for duplicate identities as part of impersonation prevention.

raw_entities.name: Check Processing Operations
raw_entities.description: The operational team responsible for implementing positive pay, verifying large checks, and monitoring check clearing times as part of check fraud prevention.
